t: Above you is Poured Lines, a 2006 painting by the British painter Ian Davenport. It hangs under the rail bridge at the western end of Southwark Street, and it is the largest painting to be publicly displayed outdoors in the United Kingdom. Davenport is an English abstract painter who was nominated for the Turner Prize. It's an unusual place for a painting, a working stretch of city street rather than a gallery, so you're seeing it the way passers-by do.
